commissions_void_has_reason.name: commissions_void_has_reason
commissions_void_has_reason.value: "commissions"."status" <> 'void' OR ("commissions"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "commissions"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL)

inspections_published_complete.name: inspections_published_complete
inspections_published_complete.value: "inspections"."status" IN ('draft', 'withdrawn') OR ("inspections"."inspected_at" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."inspector_name" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("inspections"."inspector_name")) > 0 AND "inspections"."odometer_km" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

leads_reachable.name: leads_reachable
leads_reachable.value: "leads"."phone" IS NOT NULL OR "leads"."email" IS NOT NULL

partners_account_complete.name: partners_account_complete
partners_account_complete.value: ("partners"."account_number" IS NULL AND "partners"."bank_code" IS NULL AND "partners"."account_verified_at" IS NULL AND "partners"."paystack_recipient_code" IS NULL) OR ("partners"."account_number" IS NOT NULL AND "partners"."bank_code" IS NOT NULL AND "partners"."bank_name" IS NOT NULL)

partners_recipient_needs_verification.name: partners_recipient_needs_verification
partners_recipient_needs_verification.value: "partners"."paystack_recipient_code" IS NULL OR "partners"."account_verified_at" IS NOT NULL

payouts_failed_has_reason.name: payouts_failed_has_reason
payouts_failed_has_reason.value: "payouts"."status" NOT IN ('failed', 'reversed') OR "payouts"."failure_reason" IS NOT NULL

vehicle_watches_sent_has_date.name: vehicle_watches_sent_has_date
vehicle_watches_sent_has_date.value: "vehicle_watches"."alert_status" IS DISTINCT FROM 'sent' OR "vehicle_watches"."alerted_at" IS NOT NULL

vehicles_was_price_higher.name: vehicles_was_price_higher
vehicles_was_price_higher.value: "vehicles"."was_price_minor" IS NULL OR ("vehicles"."price_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "vehicles"."was_price_minor" > "vehicles"."price_minor")
